column4: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
column5: The attributes are classified into relational, moral, fundamental, and power-related categories. Relational attributes represent how we personally experience God. Moral attributes express God's character. Fundamental attributes express the essential nature of God's existence.
